origin: DISPLAY-ONLY patch on top of v1, 2026-09-23. Adds the on-chart Comment() status panel now required (before live_candidate/live_candidate_final) by .claude/agents/ea-coder.md's 'Chart status panel' convention: identity/DEMO-LIVE line, Validated-symbols line, risk/drawdown line, Status line (RUNNING/HALTED/INIT FAILED/WARNING-not-validated), Safety line, Position line, Last line, plus a gotobi-specific block showing today's gotobi-day eligibility and the next entry window/countdown. No entry/exit/sizing/timing/safety logic changed from v1 at all -- v1's full safety ledger (consecutiveLosses, dailyHaltActive, drawdownHaltActive, balancePeak, InpAllowLiveAccount) is carried over unmodified. All of v1's review.md/VERDICT.md findings and the resulting approved_live status apply unchanged to v2, since nothing that affects trading behavior was touched. Only addition to inputs: InpValidatedSymbols (comma-separated, sourced from this same field below) which the panel reads to render the 'Validated:' line and to flag a WARNING if attached to an unvalidated symbol.
thesis: Japanese corporate 'gotobi' payment days cause a predictable pre-fixing USD-demand spike around 09:45 Tokyo time; USDJPY/EURJPY/GBPJPY tend to rise into it and drop back right after. Sell into the drop.

trading_days.rule: 5th, 10th, 15th, 20th, 25th, and last-day-of-month (30th, except February uses its actual last day)
trading_days.weekend_handling: skip the date entirely if it falls on Saturday/Sunday -- no make-up day
trading_days.approx_frequency: 4-6 trading days/month per pair, ~50 trades/year per pair

entry.broker_clock_conversion: hardcoded per calendar month, not computed via TimeGMT() (unreliable in Strategy Tester): 03:45 server time Mar-Oct, 02:45 server time Nov-Feb
skip_conditions: computed lot size below broker minimum (never rounded up)

take_profit: none -- closed by the clock, not a price target

exit.rule: market close at nominal entry time + 35 minutes, regardless of P&L, unless the stop was already hit

position_sizing.note: 0.5% risked per pair independently; up to 1.5% of account at risk across all three pairs on a gotobi day if run live as three independent EA instances

consecutive_loss_pause.resume: first day of next month, or InpResetLedgerNow=true

chart_status_panel.note: Display-only convention per .claude/agents/ea-coder.md -- does not affect trading logic.

tunable_parameters_swept: none -- every rule above was specified directly in the brief, not fit to historical data. In-sample/out-of-sample split here mainly checks whether the event-driven premise holds and whether real trading costs erode the edge, not whether Researcher curve-fit something.

demo_criteria.rationale: Low-frequency, calendar-event strategy (~4-6 trading days/month per pair) -- the day_trading category anchor (25-30 trades/14-21 days) doesn't fit; 15 trades needs roughly 3 months per pair at this cadence, so min_days=90 (calendar days elapsed) is the binding constraint, not trade count.
